title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in xdg-desktop-portal allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames. The xdg-desktop-portal service exposes D-Bus interfaces used by flatpak for file access and other operations. This flaw could allow an attacker to access host files without proper authorization. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing this issue for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 variants.
